purpose: Copyright-safe canonical registry and build-time join contract for the single PWA data pipeline.

contextNotes.derivation: Canonical in-scene adjacency + validated 004/007 semantic layers; exact addressee only when source-supported.

joinRules.speechToUnit: Within each scene, speech ordinal equals source_label_ordinal and Unit sequence is ordinal + 1 because Unit 0001 is PREAMBLE.
joinRules.unitRegistry: Read the final 002 scene registry and apply any canonical overlay named by this manifest before deriving Sentence IDs.
joinRules.unitToSentence: For each effective dialogue Unit with spoken_sentence_count K, use SEN-{UNIT_ID}-01 through SEN-{UNIT_ID}-{K:02d}.
joinRules.sentenceToChunk: Read the 003 production shards and apply any canonical chunk overlay named by this manifest; Chunk IDs use CHK-{SENTENCE_ID}-{chunk2}.
joinRules.lineVocabulary: Join by speechId; then join normalized lemma to wordDictionary.
joinRules.lineGrammar: Join by speechId. Grammar is supplemental to the structural chunk metadata in 003.
joinRules.context: Derive previous/next/cue references from canonical scene order and use materials/008_CONTEXT_NOTES.txt for interpretation policy.
joinRules.memory: Derive MEM-LINE/MEM-SEN/MEM-CHK from frozen speech/Sentence/Chunk IDs using materials/009_MEMORY_UNITS.txt.
joinRules.characters: Resolve canonical SPK-* display and role-selection metadata through materials/010_CHARACTER_INDEX.txt.

009_rehearsal.html as a canonical data authority until rebuilt against this manifest

payloadPolicy: This manifest contains IDs, counts, hashes, paths and join rules only. It does not contain the full copyrighted play text or a full translated-script payload.
